comment: The noise brush's Look rows and the five flat tip style presets built from them. On a white 1600 by 2400 document, in the mid brown, each of Firm Fill, Smeary Flat, Sea Sponge, Ribbon Pen and Graphite Pencil plays the twelve fixed strokes, a level stroke, a curve, a scrub and a short dab at the presses 0.3, 0.6 and 0.9, at the radius of 20 pixels, each sent at a pen's 240 reports a second so the sixty strokes fit the harness's frames, in a cell of 800 by 800: Firm Fill and Smeary Flat across the top, Sea Sponge and Ribbon Pen in the middle and Graphite Pencil at the bottom left, its right cell left blank. One look of the whole sheet, and a shot of the brush editor open on Ribbon Pen's Look page with every new row.
